data.exact_reserve_text: The net claims ratio, which includes the impact of movements in the Long-Term Business Provision increased by 2% to 60% for the 2018 calendar year driven by a number of high value claims on a particular binder on the 2017 year of account in the earlier part of the year. In addition, following the decision to cease underwriting, a run-off provision is included within the reserves of the Syndicate.

prior_year_events.event_name: High value claims on a particular binder
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse claims on a 2017 binder led to higher claims experience and contributed to an increase in the net claims ratio for 2018.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development table, Syndicate 44 shows net favourable development on underwriting years up to 2016, equivalent to a gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 1.18m (c.49% of the opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 2.395m). This release was partly offset in the year by adverse high-value claims on a 2017 binder and by management adding a run-off provision following the decision to cease underwriting.
raw_causal_phrases: a number of high value claims on a particular binder on the 2017 year of account in the earlier part of the year
a run-off provision is included within the reserves of the Syndicate
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 20). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision (gross)' figure was provided; the P&L prior-year claims line was disregarded per instructions. A post-balance-sheet reinsurance-to-close of Syndicate 779 into this syndicate was agreed after year end and may distort future comparisons; results here are as at 31 Dec 2018. Triangle and other figures are presented in GBP '000 in the report and were converted to millions.
